hybrid energy storage systems can be used to provide grid regulation services and can significantly improve the profitability of the regulation services providers, compared to systems using only batteries.

1) the use of hybrid electrical energy systems for regulation services improves the profitability of regulation services by up to 196% over using only batteries; and 2) a design framework that optimizes the capacity allocation and a management framework that orchestrates the different energy storage devices can realize the full potential of the HEES systems.

hybrid EES systems can be used to improve the profitability for regulation services by utilizing the high-frequency components in the regulation signal to reduce battery replacement cost, and the design and management frameworks proposed in this work are capable of maximizing the profit of such hybrid EES systems.
